celeste-rodriguez.text: "California must make it easier to stay housed, easier to work, and easier to raise children." Supports faster housing production, tenant protections, and rental assistance.

celeste-rodriguez.text: Authored AB 495 (Family Preparedness Plan Act of 2025, chaptered): broadens caregiver authorizations and guardianship options when parents face immigration-related action, and limits schools and child care facilities from collecting immigration status information.
Authored AB 2428, eliminating many criminal administrative fees and making outstanding court-imposed cost balances unenforceable, citing burdens on low-income defendants.
Authored AB 799 (chaptered), creating a death benefit of $50,000 plus half of prior-year earnings for incarcerated Conservation Camp hand crew members who die in firefighting work.
Authored AB 2160, requiring updated Department of Health Care Services guidance on Medi-Cal coverage of lactation services without prior authorization or referral requirements.
